Zdeborova, 'Statistical Physics Methods in Optimization and Machine Learning: An Introduction to Replica, Cavity & Message-Passing techniques', lecture notes, version of June 9 2024 (the PDF read page by page and as text), Sec. 4.2 (p. 59; notes.txt lines 3833-3848): 'beta^BP = 0.346 for d = 2', the zero-field Bethe-Peierls inverse temperature on a tree of connectivity c = 2d = 4 (printed, 3 digits; the printed 0.346 is atanh(1/3) = 0.34657 TRUNCATED, the others round, so every row is banked at tol 1e-3 per the ruling). Ising convention of Ch. 4: H = -J sum S_i S_j, J = 1, beta_Ising; KZ's 'assuming d = 2c' on that page is a misprint for c = 2d (the sentence before says c = 2d). In the Potts convention of Ch. 6 (beta_Potts = -2 beta_Ising) the same point is beta_stab = -ln(1 + 2/(c - 2)) (Eq. (6.13), q = 2, degree c).

(6.23) crosses 1 at c = 4

coloring_c_ann_q3.cite: F. Krzakala & L. Zdeborova, 'Statistical Physics Methods in Optimization and Machine Learning: An Introduction to Replica, Cavity & Message-Passing techniques', lecture notes, version of June 9 2024 (the PDF read page by page and as text), Sec. 6.6 (p. 108; notes.txt line 6809): 'c_ann(q = 3) = 5.4' (printed, 2 digits): the annealed threshold of Eq. (6.17) (p. 106), c_ann(beta) = -2 log q / log[1 - (1 - e^-beta)/q], at beta -> oo, where the annealed (first-moment) entropy of proper 3-colorings of G(N, M = cN/2) vanishes. Read on the PDF pages of Eqs. (6.17) and (6.24): the page names this number c_ann, the ANNEALED threshold (2 ln 3/ln(3/2) = 5.419), not the colorability threshold c_col(q = 3) (Ch. 14, task K7; not banked here). Tol 0.05: half a unit of the printed last digit (the print rounds 5.419).
coloring_c_ann_q3.independent_route: the exact first moment E Z of 3-colorings over G(N, M) (coloring/first_moment.py: a composition sum, checked against brute-force enumeration of every graph and coloring at N = 5); (1/N) ln E Z changes sign between c = 5.3 and 5.5 at N = 120 and converges to the annealed form at O(log N / N) (tests/test_potts_coloring.py)
